text: Increasing the spectral radius toward 1 lengthens the reservoir's memory but moves it closer to losing the echo state property.
explanation: True: this is the core memory-vs-stability tradeoff. Larger rho makes the memory kernel rho^k decay more slowly (longer memory), but as rho -> 1 the reservoir approaches the ESP boundary where dynamics stop contracting; beyond rho = 1 the ESP is generally lost.
